    • getObjectTypeId

      public int getObjectTypeId()
      Gets the internal object type ID. This more or less corresponds to the legacy object type ID from the HSP_OBJECT table in the Planning repository. This information is ostensibly included for posterity, it shouldn't be used for anything.
      Returns:
      the internal object type ID.

    • getTypeName

      public String getTypeName()
      Returns a friendly description of th member/object type name, which is essentially the ordinal name but in title case and spaces instead of underscores.
      Returns:
      the type description

    • valueOf

      public static PbcsMemberType valueOf(int objectTypeId)
      Parses an object type ID into an enum member. If the type cannot be determined, then this method will return UNKNOWN, which isn't a real type, but is included so that some heretofore unknown type name won't throw an exception.
      Parameters:
      objectTypeId - the numeric type value, such as from a get member info response payload
      Returns:
      the type that corresponds to that numeric type, UNKNOWN if it's unknown.
